parameters.query: SELECT c.id,s.interview_type,s.event_id,s.reviewer_emails FROM candidates c JOIN hr_interview_sessions s ON s.candidate_id=c.id WHERE c.id=$1 AND s.interview_type=$2 AND s.event_id=$3 AND $4=ANY(s.reviewer_emails) AND c.stage IN ($2::text||'_scheduled',$2::text||'_completed') AND CASE $2::text WHEN 'recruiter' THEN c.recruiter_event_id WHEN 'technical' THEN c.technical_event_id WHEN 'final' THEN c.final_event_id END=$3 LIMIT 1
